Shenzhen Lingchuang Optoelectronic Technology Co., Ltd. was founded in 2012 as a one-stop PACK component solution provider covering R&D, production, and sales of CCS, wiring harnesses, heating films, precision die-cutting, and coating. Its products are mainly used in new energy storage, power, and BBU power supplies. Storage includes large-scale storage, commercial and industrial storage, and small-scale storage. Power includes commercial vehicles, heavy trucks, ships, forklifts, and other vehicles. BBU power supplies include data centers and AI computing centers.
The company is located at the Futai Industrial Park in Shiyan, Bao'an District, Shenzhen, and has production bases in Dongguan, Hubei, and Hunan, with a well-established supply chain that can meet diverse customer needs. The company has advanced production equipment, complete testing and inspection equipment, and full-process ERP and MES systems. It has also obtained ISO 9001, IATF 16949, ISO 14001, and ISO 45001 management system certifications.
The company has strong design and R&D capabilities, as well as mass production and quality assurance capabilities, which fully ensure product reliability, stability, and consistency.
Guided by the business philosophy of "integrity builds quality, innovation leads the future," the company looks forward to growing together with its customers.

公司拥有强大的设计研发能力、产品量产及品质保证能力，充分确保产品的可靠性、稳定性与一致性。
公司秉持“诚信铸就品质、创新引领未来”的经营理念，真诚的期待与客户共同发展。

pr: CCS (Cell Contact System) integrated busbar is a core integrated component of energy storage Li-ion battery modules. It combines aluminum/copper busbars, insulating brackets, sensing circuits (FPC/FDC/sensing harness), and NTC temperature sensors in one unit. It simultaneously handles high-current series/parallel connections between cells and collects cell voltage and temperature signals, sending sampling signals to the BMS. The busbar surface is nickel-plated, offering high current-carrying capacity and low temperature rise. The insulation structure is flame-retardant and voltage-withstanding, suitable for laser welding assembly. It supports selection among FPC, FDC, and harness sensing options, and can be customized by series count, current, and shape. Produced under the IATF 16949 system, it fits energy storage and power PACK modules of various specifications.

CCS 集成母排（Cell Contact System），储能锂电模组核心集成组件，集铝 / 铜汇流巴、绝缘支架、采集线路（FPC/FDC/ 采集线束）、NTC 温感于一体，同步实现电芯大电流串并联导通、电芯电压与温度信号采集，向 BMS 传输采样信号。汇流排表面镀镍，载流能力强、温升低；绝缘结构阻燃耐压，适配激光焊接装配，支持 FPC、FDC、线束多种采集方案选型，可按串数、电流、外形定制，IATF16949 体系生产，适配各规格储能、动力 PACK 模组

CCS (Cell Contact System) integrated busbar is a core integrated component of energy storage Li-ion battery modules. It combines aluminum/copper busbars, insulating brackets, sensing circuits (FPC/FDC/sensing harness), and NTC temperature sensors in one unit. It simultaneously handles high-current series/parallel connections between cells and collects cell voltage and temperature signals, sending sampling signals to the BMS. The busbar surface is nickel-plated, offering high current-carrying capacity and low temperature rise. The insulation structure is flame-retardant and voltage-withstanding, suitable for laser welding assembly. It supports selection among FPC, FDC, and harness sensing options, and can be customized by series count, current, and shape. Produced under the IATF 16949 system, it fits energy storage and power PACK modules of various specifications.

CCS 集成母排（Cell Contact System），储能锂电模组核心集成组件，集铝 / 铜汇流巴、绝缘支架、采集线路（FPC/FDC/ 采集线束）、NTC 温感于一体，同步实现电芯大电流串并联导通、电芯电压与温度信号采集，向 BMS 传输采样信号。汇流排表面镀镍，载流能力强、温升低；绝缘结构阻燃耐压，适配激光焊接装配，支持 FPC、FDC、线束多种采集方案选型，可按串数、电流、外形定制，IATF16949 体系生产，适配各规格储能、动力 PACK 模组

This product is designed for BBU emergency power supplies in the AI server industry. It uses an integrated structural design and customized connection solutions, improving module assembly convenience while ensuring reliable quality.
产品适配AI服务器行业BBU应急电源，采用一体式结构设计，定制化连接方案，提升模组加工便利同时保障可靠品质

The PACK heating film is a core component of the battery pack thermal management system. It preheats cells in low-temperature environments, improving low-temperature charge/discharge capability, protecting cells, and preventing damage from charging at low temperatures. It uses a PI (polyimide) substrate with etched resistive circuits, offering ultra-thin flexibility, uniform heating, and high insulation voltage withstand. An option with an integrated NTC temperature sensor is available, enabling closed-loop temperature control with the BMS. It is flame-retardant, resistant to electrolyte, and resistant to vibration and aging. Size, voltage, power, and connector definitions can be customized as needed. Produced under the IATF 16949 system, it fits various energy storage and power PACK modules.
PACK 加热膜是电池包热管理核心组件，用于低温环境下电芯预加热，提升低温充放电能力、保护电芯，避免低温充电损伤。采用 PI 聚酰亚胺基材，蚀刻电阻线路，超薄柔性、升温均匀、绝缘耐压高；可选带 NTC 温感集成方案，配合 BMS 闭环控温。阻燃耐电解液、抗振动老化，按需定制尺寸、电压、功率、接点定义，IATF16949 体系生产，适配各种储能及动力PACK 模组。

The sensing harness is a BMS sampling harness supplied for Li-ion battery modules. It transmits cell voltage and temperature signals within energy storage and Li-ion PACK modules. It uses automotive-grade wire and pure nickel terminals with reliable crimping, is insulating and flame-retardant, and withstands high and low temperatures and vibration. It provides stable signal acquisition and fits BMS slave boards and CCS integrated busbars. Wire length, terminals, and connection definitions can be customized. It is produced under IATF 16949 production controls and is widely used in various energy storage and power battery packs.
采集线束，为锂电模组配套 BMS 采样线束，用于储能、锂电 PACK 模组内电芯电压、温度信号采集传输。采用汽车级线材、纯镍端子，压接可靠，绝缘阻燃，耐高低温、抗振动，信号采集稳定，适配 BMS 从控板、CCS 集成母排，定制线长、端子、连接定义，满足 IATF16949 生产管控，广泛应用于各种储能及动力电池包。

The PACK communication harness is the internal BMS communication assembly within an energy storage battery pack. It is mainly used for CAN/LIN bus data exchange between the BMS master and slave boards, transmitting signals such as battery status, faults, and balancing commands. It uses twisted-pair shielded wire to effectively suppress electromagnetic interference, ensuring stable signal transmission without packet loss. It uses automotive-grade flame-retardant wire and locking connectors, withstands high and low temperatures and vibration, and offers IP protection options. Wire length, core count, and wiring definitions can be customized. Produced under the IATF 16949 system, it fits energy storage and power PACK modules of various specifications.
PACK 通讯线束，储能电池包内部 BMS 通讯总成，主要用于 BMS 主控与从控板之间 CAN/LIN 总线数据交互，传输电池状态、故障、均衡指令等信号。采用双绞屏蔽线，有效抑制电磁干扰，信号传输稳定不丢包；汽车级阻燃线材、带锁止连接器，耐高低温、抗振动，支持 IP 防护选型，定制线长、芯数、接线定义，IATF16949 体系生产，适配各种规格储能及动力PACK模组。

FDC Flexible Sensing Ribbon Cable. It is an alternative to FPC, with clear advantages in low cost and environmental friendliness. Used with CCS busbars, it collects cell voltage, current, temperature, and other signals. It is ultra-thin and lightweight, with stable impedance, excellent insulation protection, and resistance to high and low temperatures and electrolyte. It can be formed to custom module structures and supports batch supply for energy storage PACKs. It supports early DFM collaboration and rapid sample delivery. Maximum product size: 2200 MM.
FDC 柔性采集排线，是FPC的替代方案，具有低成本、环保等明显优势；配套 CCS 母排使用，用于采集电芯电压、电流、 温度等信号。超薄轻量化，阻抗稳定，绝缘防护优异，耐高低温、耐电解液，可按模组结构定制成型，满足储能 PACK 批量配套，支持 DFM 前期协同与快速送样，最大产品尺寸2200MM。

Die-cut functional parts for PACKs and cells, including insulation, thermal insulation, buffering, fireproofing, and sealing components. Used with PACKs, cells, CCS, FDC, heating films, and other components. Base materials are matched to customer requirements. Dimensional accuracy is stable, and custom-shaped parts are supported. Maximum processing size: 2000 MM. Rapid prototyping is available, with quality control under IATF 16949.
PACK及电芯模切功能器件，包含绝缘、隔热、缓冲、防火、密封等模切组件，适用于PACK、电芯、CCS、FDC、加热膜等配套使用。按客户要求搭配配相应基材；尺寸精度稳定，支持定制异形加工，最大加工尺寸2000MM，可快速打样，IATF16949 质量管控。
